builds.summary: Fury W strikes three times for total 3*(65+.75 AD); total-AD coefficient is 2.25. Item on-hit delivery is measured separately and crit does not automatically multiply strikes.
builds.goal: Fury W strikes three times for total 3*(65+.75 AD); total-AD coefficient is 2.25. Item on-hit delivery is measured separately and crit does not automatically multiply strikes.
builds.hypothesis:
Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for [0.75] seconds and dealing a total of [(5 / 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 + (0.75) × AD) × (2)] physical damage. Hitting a champion generates an additional [10] Fury.

Fury Bonus: Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing [(5 / 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 + (0.75) × AD) × (3)] physical damage and Stunning for [1.5] seconds. Does not generate any Fury.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Start 100 Fury; W once on target; verify three strike packets and exclude shield destruction from damage. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs. Report observed damage only while the target survives; any theoretical full-window overkill is a separate raw-potential metric, not damage actually dealt.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Bloodthirster, Infinity Edge, Serylda's Grudge, Profane Hydra, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Eclipse. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: These targets are manual experiments. Partial damage adapters do not certify these whole loadouts, omitted item/rune effects or global maxima. Select the exact supported form before using a separate calculator comparison.

builds.name: Cull the Meek: Fury cleave hit
builds.summary: Explore a high 50-Fury Cull the Meek champion hit result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high 50-Fury Cull the Meek champion hit result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: At rank 5 and sufficient Fury, Q is 270 + 1.4 bonus AD physical damage per champion, compared with 180 + bonus AD ordinarily. High AD and penetration strengthen that cleave. Hitting additional champions increases total team damage and healing, not this per-target coefficient.

kitEvidence.formula:
Renekton swings his blade, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and restoring [2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 + (0.02) × AD[statFormula=2]] Health per non-champion and [12 / 20 / 28 / 36 / 44 + (0.17) × AD[statFormula=2]] per champion hit. He also generates [2.5] Fury per non-champion and [10] Fury per champion.

Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to [90 / 135 / 180 / 225 / 270 + (1.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and healing is increased to [(2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 + (0.02) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (3)] Health against non-champions and [(12 / 20 / 28 / 36 / 44 + (0.17) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (3)] Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury.
